subject: Procurement & MPA: next steps, timeline, and vendor path
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Priya Kapoor <priya.kapoor@acmecloud.com>, Tom Jenkins <tom@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Procurement & MPA: next steps, timeline, and vendor path

Hi Priya / Tom

Great to meet you both earlier. Quick recap from today's call and suggested next steps so we can keep momentum: 

Summary of call:
- AcmeCloud is evaluating Redwood for document summarization and search embed use cases (proof-of-concept).
- Preferred commercial path: Finance indicated a preference for PO (net30) over card for enterprise spend; there's also interest in listing on AcmeCloud Marketplace if timeline allows.

Procurement path & milestones (suggested):
1) Internal legal review - review SOW/Terms (we'll send a clean MPA and standard SOW)
2) Security questionnaire & evidence (SOC 2 report, architecture diagram)
3) Finance/vendor setup - vendor form + PO issuance
4) PO issued -> kickoff / reserved capacity planning

I've attached a draft mutual action plan (redwood-mpa-v1.pdf) and a pricing sheet for the POC (pricing-sheet-acmecloud.xlsx). Please confirm:
- Is PO the preferred path (vs card) for this engagement?
- Any internal timelines/holidays we should avoid?
- Who on your side owns vendor setup (legal, security, finance contacts)?

Proposed timeline (flexible):
- Week of Jun 22: Legal review complete
- Week of Jun 22-29: Security questionnaire + evidence request
- End of Jun: Finance vendor setup + PO approval
- Early Jul: PO issued, kickoff

Next step: I'll share an editable MPA with proposed milestones and a draft SOW. Would you be available for a 15-min check-in next Wed (Jun 17) to confirm owners and timeline?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

Attachments: redwood-mpa-v1.pdf, pricing-sheet-acmecloud.xlsx

From: Priya Kapoor <priya.kapoor@acmecloud.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Jenkins <tom@acmecloud.com>, vendor-ops@acmecloud.com
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Procurement & MPA: next steps, timeline, and vendor path

Thanks Marissa - useful recap. A few quick answers: 

- Yes, finance will prefer a PO (net30) for any contract over $10k/month; card is OK for ad hoc/early evaluation but for the POC scale we expect a PO.
- Vendor setup (vendor-ops@acmecloud.com) will need a vendor form and W-9. I've CC'd them.
- Legal will want to run a short review; timeline there is usually 7-10 business days unless there are redlines.

Tom and I will confirm internal owners for security and finance. Can you share the specific SOC 2 report link and a short architecture diagram we can pass to security?

Also: we're interested in marketplace listing - what's the typical lead time to get on the AcmeCloud marketplace?

Best,
Priya Kapoor
Head of Procurement Programs, AcmeCloud
priya.kapoor@acmecloud.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Priya Kapoor <priya.kapoor@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 10:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Procurement & MPA: next steps, timeline, and vendor path

Thanks Priya - adding details below and attaching a fillable MPA so your team can edit milestones.

Security & evidence:
- SOC 2 Type II (most recent): https://redwood.app/security/soc2-2025 (PDF available on request)
- Short architecture diagram attached (included in the MPA PDF). If security needs deeper artifacts (network diagram, data flow), Camila will coordinate those with your team.

Marketplace:
- Typical lead time: ~4-6 weeks once commercial terms are agreed and there's a short integration checklist. We can parallelize this with legal & security if you want.

Proposed milestone dates (editable):
- Jun 22 - Legal kickoff / initial redline window opens
- Jun 26 - Security questionnaire delivered by AcmeCloud
- Jun 30 - Finance vendor setup complete (vendor form + W-9)
- Jul 6 - PO issued (target)

Can you confirm who will own the security questionnaire on your side (name + email)? Also confirming the PO path - once vendor-ops confirms, we'll send a pro forma invoice to speed approval.

I've attached an editable MPA (mpa-acmecloud-20260612.xlsx) and will send an updated PDF with the architecture diagram.

Thanks - happy to hop on a quick call if that helps.

Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

From: Tom Jenkins <tom@acmecloud.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Priya Kapoor <priya.kapoor@acmecloud.com>
Cc: vendor-ops@acmecloud.com
Date: Sat, 13 Jun 2026 16:50:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Procurement & MPA: next steps, timeline, and vendor path

Marissa - thanks for the clarity. Quick internal notes: 

- Legal: I'll get the SOW to legal this week. Expect a 7-10 business day review window (so likely wraps the week of Jun 22).
- Security: Security will run the questionnaire next Wed (Jun 17). Contact is Rahul Mehta (rahul.mehta@acmecloud.com).
- Finance/vendor ops: vendor-ops@acmecloud.com handles the vendor form; they've requested a pro forma invoice + W-9 to start the vendor setup. Finance prefers net30 PO.

We'll plan for a PO issuance target of the first week of July, depending on redlines. I asked vendor-ops to send the vendor form link; they may request a signed contract or a DocuSign envelope (I'll share if they do).

On marketplace: Ops product will evaluate during the POC; if both sides agree we'll start the marketplace intake after legal signoff. Lead time will vary but we can aim to run that in parallel.

Tom Jenkins
Director, Platform Partnerships, AcmeCloud
tom@acmecloud.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Priya Kapoor <priya.kapoor@acmecloud.com>, Tom Jenkins <tom@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Procurement & MPA: next steps, timeline, and vendor path

Thanks all - updated MPA attached (mpa-acmecloud-20260615.xlsx) with the timeline we discussed and named owners for each milestone. Highlights: 

- Legal kickoff: Jun 15 (Tom to confirm when legal has the draft)
- Security questionnaire: Jun 17 (Rahul Mehta)
- Vendor form & W-9 submitted: Jun 18 (vendor-ops@acmecloud.com)
- Target PO issuance: Jul 6

Action items for AcmeCloud:
- Share vendor contact for vendor-ops follow-up (I'll send the pro forma invoice once I have the contact).
- Confirm legal point of contact for redlines.

Marissa will do a short check-in on Jun 17 (15 min) to confirm questionnaire ownership and any contract asks. If that works, please reply with the best time.

Thanks - looking forward to getting the MPA locked and starting the POC.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

Attachments: mpa-acmecloud-20260615.xlsx
